title: GameObjects and Components
introduction: Unity builds scene behaviour by attaching focused components to GameObjects and connecting them through references.
learningOutcomes: Describe the relationship between GameObjects and components.
Expose a private field to the Inspector with SerializeField.
Retrieve and validate a component reference.

activities.question: Which attribute exposes a supported private field in the Inspector?
activities.explanation: SerializeField asks Unity to serialise a supported private field, which also makes it editable in the Inspector by default.

activities.question: GetComponent<Rigidbody>() searches for a Rigidbody on the same GameObject.
activities.explanation: GetComponent<T>() retrieves a component of type T attached to the same GameObject, or returns null when none exists.
